attacks: Stampede attack points:10 attack energy:C attack description:

name: Bounsweet
attacks: Stampede attack points:20 attack energy:G attack description:
card_description: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
attacks: Double Spin attack points:30x attack energy:G attack description: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.
card_description: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
attacks: Three Kick Combo attack points:50x attack energy:G attack description: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
card_description: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.
